The first four commits are unchanged from the previous hand-off (in the history): see the commit bodies and review-59. Their tests and reds: DeviceLockGate portal 7b5ddc93, early Escape d0d48202, deep-URL restore 7f80c798, maturity prompt held 09115359; checks on b05574b e82a5995/0f97f19c/83316808/5c1d816d.

8a111a2 F5 (lock inertness): while locked, OverlayStackProvider's window Escape listener does nothing (isDeviceLocked()); DeviceLockGate sets inert on #root, focuses the LockScreen panel (now tabIndex -1, ref passed as a React 19 prop) and on unlock removes inert and gives focus back to the element focused before the lock, if still connected. Modal passes inert={useDeviceLocked()} to Sheet; Sheet puts inert on its scrim and skips its open-focus when it opens while inert. A dialog that opened during the lock does not take focus after unlock either; focus goes back to the pre-lock element.

8a111a2 F6: MaintenanceScreen and MandatoryUpdateScreen portal to document.body (same z-toast layer as the lock). WhatsNewPrompt takes isHeldBack; AdminFrame passes useHasUnsettledHeldWrite() so the admin registry stays out of the client bundle (cross-target check still finds none). Permission codes removed: OpeningAumForm AUTHORIZATION_DENIED ('Your role cannot record AUM.'), PasswordLinkPanel no-permission line ('Your role cannot send password links.'), and FundCreateScreen's 'funds.write and aum.write' line on the line I edited ('Your role cannot create funds.').

8a111a2 F4: domain/failure.ts exports tooManyRequestsMessage(retryAfterSeconds): 'Too many requests right now. Try again in N seconds|minutes.' (minutes rounded up from the server's Retry-After, at least 1), or '... Try again in a few minutes.' when no Retry-After came (nginx's HTML 429). describeClientFailure answers every RATE_LIMITED with it, so the per-context RATE_LIMITED rows, the base row (line 81) and the support row (358) are gone; change password, phone and nominee therefore show the remaining part of the server's 15-minute window. PasswordLinkPanel, EmailVerificationScreen, SendAction, OpeningAumForm and FundCreateScreen (now reads the mutation error) use it too. Code stays RATE_LIMITED; errors.ts untouched.

8a111a2 F3: SplashScreen re-probes reachability on the window online event while unreachable (SessionProvider already retries the restore). F1: IndividualClientGrowthScreen sets formKey '' when the selection clears on a missing-investor link, so the first key no longer remounts. F7: an invited account with no allowed action shows 'This account has not been activated yet. It can only be closed, and your role cannot close accounts.'; directoryReturns narrows to summaries with entries (type guard), so the dead 'No entry' branch is gone.

UPDATED EXISTING TEST: PasswordLinkPanel.test.tsx 'never offers it without the permission' now asserts 'Your role cannot send password links.' instead of the code line: the intended CA-23 change; it still checks that the send button is withheld.

NEW TESTS 8a111a2 (DeviceLockGate.test.tsx, rendered into a #root container): 'ignores Escape while locked, so the dialog under the lock stays open' -> red 7132f438 (OverlayStackProvider.tsx reverted to b05574b; dismiss called). 'moves focus into the lock, makes the app and its dialogs inert, keeps a dialog opened while locked from taking focus, and gives focus back on unlock' -> red a4f94649 (DeviceLockGate, Modal, Sheet, LockScreen reverted; focus not in the lock), red 442e6d2d (Modal and Sheet only reverted; the scrim is not inert), red 8de4375b (only Sheet's focus skip removed, inert kept; the dialog opened while locked took focus, line 105). Each restored, cmp identical, tree clean after.

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): unchanged reasoning; no request, response, route, error code, header, cookie or stored key changes in any commit; the held-write registry is memory only. Released APKs and the previous release are unaffected.

RUNTIME STEPS (UNVERIFIED, no browser run here): (1) 429 with nginx-like HTML: 'Too many requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.'; the server's own JSON RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After: change password three wrong times then again -> 'Try again in N minutes' (up to 15); email code resend -> 'Try again in 1 minute' and 'Send another in m:ss'; reset shows no 'Request a new link'. (2) Admin /users reload with the session read failing -> error with Try again; back online -> page restores. Client native cold start offline -> splash 'We can't reach BeOnEdge'; back online -> splash re-probes and continues. (3) /client-values/individual, also with ?userId=<missing uuid>: typing in Investor keeps focus and the form. (4) Unconfirmed 'Set a maturity date': neither the maturity prompt nor What's new opens until it settles. (5) Opening AUM refusal shows only 'Opening AUM not recorded'. (6) /users no entries -> 'No recorded investment'. (7) Own record: only the line; invited client seen by an admin with users.suspend only: the invited line. (8) Escape right after a confirm opens closes it. Native: open a dialog, lock on resume: lock covers it, Escape does nothing, focus is in the lock, Tab cannot reach the dialog (inert), unlock returns focus. Maintenance or mandatory update with a dialog open: the block screen covers it.

DOUBTFUL / LEFT: (a) Lock and the two block screens share z-toast at body level, so whichever mounts later paints on top; a block screen arriving while locked shows above the lock (it shows no figures, and #root stays inert). (b) Other admin screens still name permission codes (MandateDetailScreen, EmailTemplateDetailScreen, AppUpdateAnnouncementPanel, ApplicationDetailScreen, AppConfigBuilderScreen, FundSizeAdjustmentForm, FundAumScreen, ClientPositionsScreen, EarlierInvestmentForm, ClientPositionDetailScreen, UserLifecyclePanel's sibling panels): not in this brief; a CA-23 sweep would cover them. (c) The prompt's arm step can still stack if another overlay opens in the very commit it shows (rare). (d) Plan section 8 entry and closing finding-55/60/62, review-42/46/59 items are the coordinator's (rule-50).

COMMITS on track/p-lows (not pushed, rebased or landed), on 0b337a0: b61aa91 fix(overlays): keep the lock screen above dialogs and close on early Escape; 847ebf5 fix(session): show Try again when a deep-URL restore meets an outage; 8916418 fix(copy): word rate-limit refusals so they hold for a proxy limit too; b05574b fix(admin): hold the maturity prompt behind held writes; panel leftovers. ITEM 5 (review-46 F5, b61aa91): #root has isolation: isolate, so the LockScreen rendered inside it could never paint above a Modal portaled to body. DeviceLockGate now portals LockScreen to document.body, where BLOCK_LAYER's z-toast (1000) outranks the sheet scrim's z-overlay (900). Overlay tree and its form state untouched while locked.

ITEM 6 (b61aa91): Modal registers in useLayoutEffect; OverlayStackProvider keeps the order in a ref read synchronously by register, dismissTop and the window Escape listener (listener bound once). ids state still drives depth/topId and the scroll lock; register stays a no-op when already on top (15f1289 loop guard kept; the existing fixed-point tests pass).

ITEM 2 (finding-55, 847ebf5): RequireSession shows ErrorState (variant from errorVariantOf) with Try again -> retryRestore when status is restoring with an error. SessionProvider adds a window online listener while a restore is held by an outage and bumps the restore nonce. Principal, token store and holds untouched, so finding-57 residue (2) is unchanged; anonymous restores still redirect to sign-in.

ITEM 1 (finding-62 item 2, 8916418): one copy 'Too many requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.' for the reset link, change password, admin password link and email code; also, by rule 15, the other failure.ts context entries that named a cause or a 15-minute wait (changePhone, sendNomineeRequest, requestEmailChange, requestPasswordReset, and the unused sendVerificationCode/checkVerificationCode) and admin SendAction's 'a moment ago'. Base RATE_LIMITED and support copy unchanged. Code stays RATE_LIMITED; errors.ts untouched, so Check again stays unknown. ResetPasswordScreen offers 'Request a new link' only for INVALID_CREDENTIALS now (the server's own reset 429 is the password hasher queue, so the link is still good). EmailVerificationScreen starts its cooldown only when retryAfterSeconds is set: http.ts sets it only for a parsed JSON envelope with Retry-After, so the server's own limit starts it and nginx's HTML 429 never does (the old ?? 60 fallback is gone).

ITEM 3 (finding-60, b05574b): new features/admin/shared/unsettledHeldWrites.ts (in-memory set + useSyncExternalStore); useHeldWrite marks itself while it holds a body (pending, unknown, expired) or an unreadable hold. MaturityDuePrompt opens only when no held write is unsettled and overlay depth is 0, arming one effect first like WhatsNewPrompt, and latches open once shown (its own Modal and the action dialogs do not close it).

ITEM 3 search: IndividualClientGrowthScreen keys the form by the last chosen investor (formKey), not the current selection, so the first key (which clears the selection) no longer remounts the form/picker; choosing a different investor still remounts to restore that investor's growth hold. InvestorPicker takes optional initialQuery so the remounted picker shows the chosen name (it was blank after a pick before).

ITEM 3 AUM and /users: OpeningAumForm with hasAum and a refusal (not locked) returns only the notices, i.e. the 'Opening AUM not recorded' alert, without the 'Unconfirmed opening AUM / never confirmed' section. directoryReturns treats a summary with lastUpdatedAt null (backend latestOf: no ledger facts) as 'No recorded investment' in all four columns, like an absent summary.

ITEM 4 (review-42, b05574b): UserLifecyclePanel renders the Reason field and the action row only when an action is offered (so the own record shows only its line); no-permission line is now 'Your role cannot suspend, reinstate or close accounts.' A closed account with permissions shows 'This account is closed and cannot be reopened from here.' so the card is not left empty (added by me; drop if unwanted).

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): no request or response shape, route, error code, header, cookie or stored key changes; the held-write registry is memory only. Released APKs and the previous release are unaffected; an images-only rollback restores the old frontend with nothing stored differently.
